required_when: operation catalog IDs aliases or modules change
validation: JSON parse, index/catalog sync review, and adapter validator
relationships.approval_trigger: weakened operation gate or routing rule

required_when: operation catalog user-facing help changes
validation: manual help and help-reference sync review
relationships.approval_trigger: operation availability or allowed-action claim changes

required_when: operation candidates, aliases, or profile routing changes
validation: JSON parse and operation-routing flow review
relationships.approval_trigger: weakened approval, profile, or module-state routing

nodes.project_area: project/assistant-adapter
coverage_evidence: Preserved schema-2 relationship coverage during the Alatyr 0.1.0-alpha.33 migration; no new relationship was accepted.

required_when: blueprint source-of-truth ownership or derived surfaces change
validation: registry and consistency-map sync review
relationships.approval_trigger: source-of-truth routing or ownership change

required_when: blueprint operation or module enablement statements change
validation: module profile and adapter validator review
relationships.approval_trigger: enabled module or blueprint workflow change

required_when: blueprint-driven workflow changes
validation: manual flow and router sync review
relationships.approval_trigger: accepted behavior, architecture, data, or public-contract workflow change

nodes.project_area: process/assistant-adapter
coverage_evidence: Preserved schema-2 relationship coverage during the Alatyr 0.1.0-alpha.33 migration; no new relationship was accepted.

required_when: development evidence capture or recommendation patterns change
validation: JSON parse, flow review, and privacy boundary review
relationships.approval_trigger: enabling or weakening development evidence capture

required_when: effectiveness metrics or summarized recommendation evidence changes
validation: manual template and development-evidence sync review
relationships.approval_trigger: persistent assistant recommendation or effectiveness record change

required_when: later task outcomes are linked to completed effectiveness evidence
validation: JSON parse and append-only evidence policy review
relationships.approval_trigger: persistent delayed-outcome evidence policy changes

required_when: framework maintenance effort is measured separately from product work
validation: JSON parse and measurement-boundary review
relationships.approval_trigger: persistent adapter-maintenance evidence policy changes

required_when: multi-surface change package tracking is used
validation: JSON parse and change-package index review
relationships.approval_trigger: persistent change package evidence or approval scope changes

nodes.project_area: assistant-adapter/ai-infrastructure/full-profile
coverage_evidence: Preserved schema-2 relationship coverage during the Alatyr 0.1.0-alpha.33 migration; no new relationship was accepted.

The target support policy classifies every Git-visible .ai file and the installed root assistant entry points as Alatyr support, so those paths bind to this existing adapter-capability node for impact routing.

required_when: enabled module graph or capability ownership changes
validation: adapter validator plus module closure audit
relationships.approval_trigger: weakening capability gates or enabling external permissions

required_when: adapter installation update repair acceptance or health state changes
validation: installation transition continuity and strict acceptance validation
relationships.approval_trigger: changing accepted adapter state without matching validation evidence

required_when: selected assistants instruction loading skills permissions diagrams delegation or bridge contracts change
validation: assistant capability schema and selected-runtime evidence review
relationships.approval_trigger: selecting a new assistant or broadening permission and authorization claims

required_when: profile, area, intent, or task-scale routing changes
validation: JSON parse and router/profile sync review
relationships.approval_trigger: broadening protected action scope or changing required context

required_when: installed framework, project, assistant, routing, or semantic-codebook content changes
validation: regenerate and validate all three recursive contour indexes, semantic references, word estimates, and content digests
relationships.approval_trigger: stale or broadened context routing after protected adapter changes

required_when: manifest, module profile, operation catalog, gates, router, context catalogs, or semantic codebook changes
validation: bootstrap regeneration and adapter validator
relationships.approval_trigger: stale bootstrap after capability surface change

required_when: gate catalog or approval boundary changes
validation: JSON parse and gate index review
relationships.approval_trigger: weakening capability gates or protected approvals

required_when: project-knowledge routing, promotion, or packet policy changes
validation: adapter validator plus project-knowledge policy and index review
relationships.approval_trigger: accepting promoted knowledge, changing canonical-owner routing, or weakening retention/redaction policy

required_when: source, test, documentation, validation, or authoring-rule surfaces change
validation: adapter validator and authoring-rule sync review
relationships.approval_trigger: weakening assistant-facing code authoring rules
